propositions: Extract identity transition call graph (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle while preserving exact existing behavior and facade signatures.

Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity, verified by table-driven tests over valid/missing/corrupt/duplicate/stale combinations and reloaded from disk.
bind_confirm applies last-writer-wins to forward entry and pops exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, detection, or ambiguity abort.
Stale reverse entries removed only in permitted cases: rebind (old key differs), unbind (sweep orphans), re-key (old key popped on insert), and retire.
Immutable numeric-ID re-key swaps both indexes, resets absence count, and moves issues instead of retiring them; legacy no-ID records degrade to note_absent.
note_absent_or_rekey remains facade-owned coordinator; only step-4 re-key mutation moves to BindingLifecycle.rekey, which returns False on unchanged or absent key to collapse both absence branches.
